_readme: The single source of truth for the programme. Every entry becomes: a row in the home-page schedule, its own page at /events/<slug>/, and a .ics calendar file. To add an event, copy an object and fill it in — nothing else to touch. Times are 24h local (Canberra). Set links.humanitix / links.rubric when listings go live and buttons appear automatically.

events.title: Tech Talks Conference
events.blurb: A day of computing and cybersecurity talks from industry and academic speakers — ideas talks, deep technical sessions, and true-crime incident stories, in 25 and 50 minute slots. Morning tea (11:45am–12pm) and lunch (1–1:45pm) provided — indicate dietary requirements when registering on Humanitix.

events.title: BushBash CTF Launch
events.blurb: The 48-hour BushBash CTF goes live at 5pm — doors open from 4:45pm. Form a team, meet other players, and start capturing flags across OSINT, Rev, Pwn, Web, Crypto and Misc.

events.title: BushBash CTF — Day Two
events.blurb: The competition continues all day in Melville Hall, with non-technical brain-break activities like GeoGuessr and Wikipedia racing alongside the main board.

events.title: Free BBQ Lunch
events.blurb: Free BBQ lunch at Copland Courtyard BBQ for everyone at the festival.

events.title: Movie Night: The Matrix
events.blurb:
Wind down day two of Bush Week Tech Fest with our fun, social screening of The Matrix! We’ve booked out a cinema just for us, because there’s no better way to finish a day of hacking than with the classic film about one of pop culture’s most famous fictional hackers. 

If you’re up to it, break out your sunglasses and a black/leather outfit to watch The Matrix in The-Matrix-style 😎

events.title: BushBash CTF Finale & Prizes
events.blurb: The final hours of the CTF — flags close at 5pm sharp. Then from 5:00–5:30pm, Kylie McDevitt (CEO) and Silvio Cesare (CTO) of InfoSect co-present the closing ceremony, prizes and award certificates — followed by pizza.

events.title: Free BBQ Lunch
events.blurb: Free BBQ lunch on Fellows Oval — day two.

events.title: Networking & Drinks Night
events.includes: Two drink tokens + food per ticket
events.blurb: Cap off the festival with an evening of networking and drinks in the city with speakers, sponsors and fellow students. We've booked out Bar Lola and Dear Prudence at Verity Lane Market for up to 100 guests, and every $7.50 dirt-cheap ticket gets you two drink tokens and food. 18+ — bring photo ID.
